verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own docs say users can install or connect MCP servers and use them with local models, so the product directly provides MCP-client capability. However, the evidence is only one-line feature statements with no setup, transport, or tool-permission detail. A hands-on community report describes a poor first experience: an MCP task got stuck in an infinite loop. That report concerns reliability, not whether the capability exists, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: documented configuration and transport details for adding MCP servers, documented tool-invocation and approval behavior, and independent corroboration that MCP tool use works reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
